entity.title: SyncAction
entity.description: A GitHub Action that synchronizes templates from the central repository to target repositories.

rules.body: IS a GitHub Action that synchronizes templates from the central repository to target repositories.
MUST be triggered on push to the central repository when template or manifest files change.
MUST support manual dispatch via `workflow_dispatch`.
MUST read the SyncManifest to determine templates and targets.
MUST resolve target repositories via the GitHub API using the ComponentRegistry.
For each target repository, MUST check the DeploymentState to determine if an update is needed.
For each out-of-date target, MUST render the template using the configured strategy and create or update a SyncPullRequest.
MUST NOT fail the entire workflow when a single target repository fails.
MUST handle GitHub API rate limiting with exponential backoff.
SHOULD use concurrency groups to prevent parallel sync operations from conflicting.
HAS an input `dry-run` (boolean, default: false) which when true prevents any PRs from being created or updated.
HAS an input `target-filter` (string, optional) to limit sync to repositories whose `owner/repo` matches any of a comma-separated list of glob patterns; a malformed pattern fails the run.
HAS an input `template-filter` (string, optional) to limit sync to templates whose identifier matches any of a comma-separated list of glob patterns; a malformed pattern fails the run.
HAS an input `force` (boolean, default: false) which when true forces sync even if DeploymentState shows current version.
HAS an input `config-path` (string, default: "steerspec-sync.yml") to specify an alternate config file path.
HAS an output `prs-created` (integer) counting the number of new PRs created.
HAS an output `prs-updated` (integer) counting the number of existing PRs updated.
HAS an output `repos-skipped` (integer) counting the repository and template pairs that sync left unchanged without an error: already up to date, a symlinked destination, or a dry run.
HAS an output `errors` (integer) counting the repository and template pairs that failed, plus one when the DeploymentState could not be saved.
HAS an output `summary` (JSON string) containing a detailed summary of the sync operation including per-repo results.
A reference implementation IS RECOMMENDED in Go as a composite GitHub Action.
The reference implementation SHOULD be published as a reusable GitHub Action.
MUST isolate errors per target repository, continuing with the other targets when one fails.

notes.content: Per-repo error isolation prevents a single misconfigured or inaccessible repo from blocking updates to all other repos.
